info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Cosmetics Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Cosmetics Production Detail API facilitates the creation of detailed records for cosmetic products within a catalog. This API allows users to submit comprehensive information about cosmetics including ingredients, packaging, and production specifics. Typical consumers of this API include product development teams, marketing departments, and inventory managers who need to manage and showcase cosmetic offerings effectively. By enabling detailed product entries, the API enhances catalog organization and supports better customer engagement in the cosmetics industry.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for cosmetic products, facilitating the addition of new entries to the cosmetics produce database. Ensure all required fields are filled out accurately for successful submission.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details necessary for the production of cosmetics. It includes various parameters that specify the formulation, ingredients, and other essential aspects required to successfully process the cosmetics production request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.
